builds a namespace's entries ahead of the reads that would miss them

Usage: dolos cache warm [OPTIONS] --namespace <NAMESPACE> <--keys <KEYS>|--previous|--scan>

Options:
      --namespace <NAMESPACE>  the namespace to warm
      --keys <KEYS>            a file of keys, one per line, in the namespace's text form
      --previous               the keys the namespace held when it was last wiped
      --scan                   the keys the namespace's use finds worth warming
  -c, --config <CONFIG>        
  -h, --help                   Print help
